brand.purpose: "FTC Ultimate" in the lockup; names only.

label.purpose: Field labels and menu group headings, muted.

shadows.name: btn-shadow

shadows.name: focus
shadows.purpose: Focus ring on every focusable element.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action in a dialog or screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 42px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #5aa9ff, #3d6ff2); color: #fff; font: 600 16px/1.45 Saira, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45), 0 2px 6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(91 155 255 / 0.85); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Everything else, including actions repeated on every row (blue text).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 42px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; background: #1f2640; color: #eef1f8; font: 600 16px/1.45 Saira, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45), 0 2px 6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary.ds-accent { color: #5b9bff; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #283152; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(91 155 255 / 0.85); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive actions: red text on a faint red wash.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { min-height: 42px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #ff6b7d 10%, #161b2e); color: #ff6b7d; font: 600 16px/1.45 Saira, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45), 0 2px 6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #ff6b7d 20%, #161b2e); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(91 155 255 / 0.85); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Inputs sit pressed into the surface, labels above in muted text.
components.css: .ds-label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font: 500 0.875rem Saira, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #8f98b5; } .ds-input { min-height: 42px; padding: 8px 12px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; background: #11162a; color: #eef1f8; font: 400 1rem Saira, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5), 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.09); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6b7493; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(91 155 255 / 0.85); }

components.name: Tag Chip and Status Badge
components.description: Round chips are tags; squared badges are status, tinted by meaning.
components.html: Low stock on order to order
components.css: .ds-tag { min-height: 0; padding: 2px 10px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #5b9bff 12%, transparent); color: #9cc2ff; font: 500 0.8rem Saira, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tag:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #5b9bff 22%, transparent); } .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: #1f2640; color: #8f98b5; font: 600 0.8rem/1.45 Saira, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-low { color: #ff6b7d; background: color-mix(in srgb, #ff6b7d 8%, transparent); } .ds-onorder { color: #f2b84b; background: color-mix(in srgb, #f2b84b 8%, transparent); } .ds-toorder { color: #5b9bff; background: color-mix(in srgb, #5b9bff 8%, transparent); }

components.name: Quantity Stepper
components.description: Big bold count between round −/+ buttons; the core shop action.
components.css: .ds-qty { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-family: Saira, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #eef1f8; } .ds-qty span { min-width: 3ch; text-align: center; font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-step { width: 32px; height: 32px; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: #1f2640; color: #eef1f8; font-size: 1.1rem; line-height: 1; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45), 0 2px 6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25); cursor: pointer; } .ds-step:hover { background: #283152; } .ds-step:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(91 155 255 / 0.85); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Surface panel separated by tone and a soft shadow, no border.
components.html:
Team

Share the join code with new teammates.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 20px; border-radius: 16px; background: #161b2e; color: #eef1f8; font-family: Saira, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4), 0 4px 14px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25); } .ds-card h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: #8f98b5; }

components.name: Menu
components.description: Raised floating menu with muted icons; current item in blue.
components.css: .ds-menu { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 220px; padding: 6px; border-radius: 12px; background: #1f2640; box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5); } .ds-menu-item { padding: 8px 10px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; background: none; color: #eef1f8; font: 500 1rem Saira, system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-menu-item:hover { background: #1c2238; } .ds-menu-item.ds-current { background: color-mix(in srgb, #5b9bff 15%, transparent); color: #5b9bff; } .ds-menu-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(91 155 255 / 0.85); }

components.name: Brand Lockup
components.description: Orbitron name: "FTC Ultimate" heavy over the lighter blue app name.
components.css: .ds-brand { font: 800 1.6rem/1.15 Orbitron, sans-serif; color: #eef1f8; } .ds-brand span { display: block; } .ds-brand .ds-app { font-weight: 500; color: #5b9bff; }

narrative.overview:
The app reads like a well-kept parts map for a robotics shop. Behind the first screens and the guides sits a dark navy topographic map, fading to a brighter blue in one corner, with thin blue contour lines drifting slowly as you scroll. Once you're inside the inventory, the map pulls back to a faint band behind the header and the work takes over: dense, scannable rows of parts, big quantity numbers, and controls sized for quick taps between builds.

It's a tool first. Expression lives in a few precise places: the split cube logo, the Orbitron lockup ("FTC Ultimate" heavy, "Inventory" lighter and blue), the contour lines, and one blue gradient reserved for the action that matters. Everything else is calm navy layers that separate by tone and soft shadow, never by outlines.

Dark is the default and the home of the brand. Light mode (named "Pain and suffering mode" in the ☰ menu) is a full, careful equivalent, not an afterthought. The same tokens swap underneath.
keyCharacteristics: Navy tonal layers (bg, surface, raised) with soft shadows instead of borders.
One blue accent, with a gradient only on primary buttons, switches and the marked storage spot.
Orbitron only for names (app lockup, app switcher, guide headings, stylized labels); Saira for everything else, with tabular numbers.
Thin topo-line background on entry screens and guides, a faded band on the inventory header.
Shop-ready density: 42px controls, big −/+ steppers, cards on phones.

rules.name: The One Gradient Rule
rules.body: A dialog has one gradient button. Actions repeated on every row are secondary, with blue text.

rules.name: The Tone, Not Line Rule
rules.body: Surfaces separate by tone and `--card-shadow`. Borders stay transparent; `border` is only for dividers between rows and sections.

rules.name: The Meaning Colors Rule
rules.body: Red means a problem, amber means waiting. Never use them for decoration.

rules.name: The Names In Orbitron Rule
rules.body: Orbitron is for names: the app lockup, the app switcher, guide headings and stylized labels. Never for body text, buttons or data.

rules.name: The No Border Rule
rules.body: Buttons and surfaces have no visible border. Depth comes from tone and shadow.

dos: **Do** use the CSS custom properties in `src/style.css` for every color and shadow, so dark and light both work.
**Do** keep one gradient button per dialog; make repeated row actions secondary.
**Do** separate surfaces with tone and `--card-shadow`, and keep borders transparent.
**Do** set Orbitron only on names, and Saira with tabular numbers everywhere else.
**Do** keep controls at least 42px tall (steppers 32–56px) and respect `prefers-reduced-motion` for the drift, shimmer, switch and found pulse.
**Do** put supplier photos on a white tile in both themes.
donts: **Don't** add visible borders around buttons, cards or menus.
**Don't** use red or amber for decoration; they mean problem and waiting.
**Don't** make status badges round; round is for tag chips.
**Don't** use the blue gradient beyond primary buttons, switches, the marked spot and the update and news banners.
**Don't** add anything that looks AI-generated: no generic glassmorphism, glows, sparkle icons or stock gradients outside the brand's own.
**Don't** use the other apps' orange or green outside the app switcher.
